stage1.title: Weeks 1–4 · Beginning and Implantation
stage1.body: Everything is just beginning. Your body is preparing for tiny but important changes. 💗

stage2.title: Weeks 5–8 · Foundations Are Forming
stage2.body: Small developments are moving quickly. You may also begin to notice more changes in your body.

stage3.title: Weeks 9–13 · Moving Into the Fetal Period
stage3.body: You have moved through most of the earliest weeks. Your baby becomes a little more distinct each day. ✨

stage4.title: Weeks 14–17 · Rapid Growth
stage4.body: As your baby grows quickly, you are continuing to settle into this new stage of pregnancy.

stage5.title: Weeks 18–22 · First Movements
stage5.body: These are special weeks when you may begin to notice those tiny movements. 🫶

stage6.title: Weeks 23–27 · Growing Stronger
stage6.body: Your baby’s movements may now feel more distinct. There is a small but very active world inside.

stage7.title: Weeks 28–31 · Maturing
stage7.body: Your baby continues to grow and gain strength. You are moving gently toward meeting each other. 🤍

stage8.title: Weeks 32–35 · Preparing for Birth
stage8.body: You are getting closer. As your baby prepares for life after birth, your body is preparing too.

stage9.title: Weeks 36–40+ · Final Weeks
stage9.body: The time to meet is drawing closer. Remember to be a little gentler with yourself in these final weeks. 🌷
